<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function ($scope, $location, $sce) {
	var c = this;
	c.acking = {};
	c.activeLetter = null;
	c.searchQuery = '';
	c.timeFilter = 'last12';

	// Dynamically calculates total awarded amount based on currently filtered cards
	c.getTotalAwarded = function () {
		var list = c.filteredAwards();
		var sum = 0;
		for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
			sum += parseFloat(list[i].award_amount || 0);
		}
		return sum;
	};

	c.activeAwardCount = function () {
		return c.filteredAwards().length;
	};

	c.awaitingAckCount = function () {
		if (!c.data.awards) return 0;
		return c.data.awards.filter(function (a) {
			return a.applicant_response === 'pending';
		}).length;
	};

	c.acknowledgedCount = function () {
		if (!c.data.awards) return 0;
		return c.data.awards.filter(function (a) {
			return a.applicant_response === 'acknowledged';
		}).length;
	};

	// Search + time-range filtering, applied client-side over the existing dataset
	c.filteredAwards = function () {
		if (!c.data.awards) return [];
		var list = c.data.awards;

		if (c.searchQuery && c.searchQuery.trim() !== '') {
			var q = c.searchQuery.toLowerCase();
			list = list.filter(function (a) {
				return (a.number || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) > -1 ||
					(a.program_name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) > -1;
			});
		}

		if (c.timeFilter === 'last12') {
			var cutoff = new Date();
			cutoff.setMonth(cutoff.getMonth() - 12);

			list = list.filter(function (a) {
				var dateStr = a.award_start_date || a.sys_created_on || a.award_end_date;
				if (!dateStr) return false;
				var d = new Date(dateStr);
				return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? false : d >= cutoff;
			});
		}

		return list;
	};

	c.amountPercent = function (award) {
		if (!c.data.awards || c.data.awards.length === 0) return 0;
		var max = Math.max.apply(null, c.data.awards.map(function (a) { return a.award_amount || 0; }));
		return max > 0 ? Math.round((award.award_amount / max) * 100) : 0;
	};

	c.displayStatus = function (award) {
		if (!award) return '';
		if (award.applicant_response === 'pending') return 'Acknowledgement pending';
		return award.applicant_response_display || 'Acknowledged';
	};

	// Handles acknowledgement with robust server action and automatic widget refresh
	c.acknowledgeAward = function (award, $event) {
		if ($event) $event.stopPropagation();
		if (!award || !award.sys_id) return;
		
		c.acking[award.sys_id] = true;

		c.server.get({
			action: 'acknowledge_award',
			sys_id: award.sys_id
		}).then(function (response) {
			c.acking[award.sys_id] = false;
			// Forces server script re-evaluation to update summary counts and banners instantly
			c.server.update();
		}, function (error) {
			c.acking[award.sys_id] = false;
			alert('Unable to process award acknowledgement.');
		});
	};

	c.openAwardLetter = function (award, $event) {
		if ($event) $event.stopPropagation();

		if (!award.award_letter) {
			alert('No award letter is available yet for ' + award.number + '.');
			return;
		}

		c.activeLetter = {
			sys_id: award.sys_id,
			number: award.number,
			program_name: award.program_name,
			award_amount: award.award_amount,
			award_end_date: award.award_end_date,
			reporting_frequency: award.reporting_frequency,
			applicant_response: award.applicant_response,
			applicant_response_display: award.applicant_response_display,
			award_letter: award.award_letter, 
			html: $sce.trustAsHtml(award.award_letter)
		};
	};

	c.closeAwardLetter = function () {
		c.activeLetter = null;
	};

	// Handles downloading the letter cleanly as a text file format
	c.downloadAwardLetter = function (award, $event) {
		if ($event) {
			$event.stopPropagation();
		}

		if (!award) return;

		if (award.attachment_sys_id) {
			window.open('/sys_attachment.do?sys_id=' + award.attachment_sys_id, '_blank');
			return;
		}

		var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
		tempDiv.innerHTML = award.award_letter || '';
		var cleanText = tempDiv.innerText || tempDiv.textContent || '';

		var fileContent = 'OFFICIAL AWARD LETTER: ' + award.number + '\n';
		if (award.program_name) {
			fileContent += 'Program: ' + award.program_name + '\n';
		}
		fileContent += '--------------------------------------------------\n\n';
		fileContent += cleanText;

		var blob = new Blob([fileContent], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
		var link = document.createElement('a');
		link.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
		link.download = 'Award_Letter_' + award.number + '.txt';
		
		document.body.appendChild(link);
		link.click();
		document.body.removeChild(link);
	};

	c.openProject = function () {
		alert('Project link is not available yet for this award.');
	};

	c.openAward = function (award) {
		if (!award) return;
		$location.search({ id: c.data.detail_page || 'my_award_detail', sys_id: award.sys_id });
	};
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* ══ RESET & VARS ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
:root {
  --brand:      #312782;
  --brand-lt:   #ede9fe;
  --green:      #059669; --green-lt: #dcfce7;
  --amber:      #d97706; --amber-lt: #fef3c7;
  --red:        #e11d48; --red-lt:   #fee2e2;
  --slate-900:  #0f172a; --slate-700: #334155; --slate-500: #64748b;
  --slate-300:  #cbd5e1; --slate-200: #e2e8f0; --slate-100: #f1f5f9; --slate-50: #f8fafc;
  --white:      #ffffff;
  --r-md: 16px; 
  --r-lg: 24px;
}
  
/* ══ LAYOUT ═════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.gn-layout {
  margin: 35px -15px 0 -15px;
  width: calc(100% + 30px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: #f8f9fa;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
  
.aw-sidebar {
  width: 240px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--brand);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  height: 100vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 10;
}
  
.aw-main {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 32px 40px 72px;
  background: #f8f9fa;
}
  
/* ══ PAGE HEADER ═════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.aw-ph {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.aw-ph-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.aw-ph-title { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--slate-900); margin-bottom: 4px; letter-spacing: -0.5px; }
.aw-ph-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--slate-500); }
.aw-sub-highlight { font-weight: 600; color: var(--slate-700); }
  
.aw-ph-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.aw-search-box, .aw-filter-group {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  background: var(--white); border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8);
  border-radius: 99px;
  padding: 8px 16px; 
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
}
.aw-search-box { min-width: 240px; }
.aw-search-box i, .aw-filter-group i { color: var(--slate-500); font-size: 12px; }
.aw-search-box input { border: none; outline: none; font-size: 13px; width: 100%; background: transparent; }
.aw-time-filter { border: none; outline: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slate-700); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; }
  
.aw-icon-btn, .aw-avatar {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.aw-icon-btn { border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8); background: var(--white); color: var(--slate-500); font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02); }
.aw-avatar { background: var(--brand); color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; }
  
/* ══ GLASS CARD STYLES ══════════════════════════════════════ */
.aw-stat-tile, .aw-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.01);
}
  
/* ══ SUMMARY TILES ROW ══════════════════════════════════════ */
.aw-summary-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  width: 100%;
}
.aw-stat-tile {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px;
}
.aw-tile-lbl { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slate-500); letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.aw-tile-val { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: -1px; }
.aw-tile-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--slate-500); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  
/* Color classes for tiles & highlights */
.aw-text-indigo { color: #312782 !important; }
.aw-text-dark { color: #0f172a !important; }
.aw-text-amber { color: #d97706 !important; }
  
/* ══ ACKNOWLEDGEMENT ALERT BANNER ══════════════════════════ */
.aw-ack-alert {
  display: flex; 
  align-items: center; 
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20px 24px; 
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  width: 100%;
  background: #fff5f5 !important;
  border: 1px solid #fed7d7 !important;

}
.aw-ack-alert-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.aw-ack-alert-icon {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--red-lt); color: var(--red);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 16px; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.aw-ack-title-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 4px; }

}
.aw-badge--red { background: var(--red-lt); color: var(--red); }

.aw-text-dark-bold { font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; }
  
.aw-cta--solid {
  background: #312782 !important; 
  color: #ffffff !important; 
  border: none !important;
  padding: 12px 24px !important; 
  border-radius: 99px !important; 
  font-size: 13px !important; 
  font-weight: 600 !important; 
  cursor: pointer !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  visibility: visible !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(49, 39, 130, 0.15);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.aw-cta--solid span { color: #ffffff !important; }
.aw-cta--solid:hover { background: #251d66 !important; transform: translateY(-1px); }
  
/* ══ EXECUTIVE AWARD LETTER MODAL REDESIGN ══════════════════ */
.aw-letter-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);
  backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 24px;
  animation: awFadeIn .2s ease both;
}
  
.aw-letter-modal {
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 720px;
  max-height: 88vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25);
  border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8);
  animation: awModalIn .25s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both;
}
  
/* Header Strip */
.aw-letter-modal-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 24px 32px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand) 0%, #4338ca 100%);
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--amber);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.aw-letter-header-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}
.aw-letter-badge {
  width: 46px; height: 46px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  color: #ffffff;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.aw-letter-eyebrow {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.aw-letter-modal-header h3 {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  margin: 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.2px;
}

.aw-letter-close {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border: none;
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 20px;

  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}
.aw-letter-close:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
}
  
/* Quick-facts strip */
.aw-letter-facts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 20px 32px;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.aw-letter-fact { 
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  display: flex; 
  flex-direction: column; 
  gap: 4px; 
}
.aw-letter-fact-lbl {
  font-size: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: #64748b;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.aw-letter-fact-val {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--slate-900);

.aw-letter-modal-body {
  padding: 32px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.8;

  background: #ffffff;
}

.aw-letter-modal-body ul { margin: 0 0 16px 0; padding-left: 20px; }
.aw-letter-modal-body li { margin-bottom: 6px; }

  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 12px;

  border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;

  flex-shrink: 0;
}

  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  color: #334155;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.aw-letter-btn-secondary:hover { 
  background: #f1f5f9; 
  border-color: #94a3b8;
}
  
/* DEFINITIVE FIX: Guaranteed Solid Visibility Download Button */
.aw-letter-btn-primary {
  background-color: #312782 !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  border: 1px solid #312782 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 10px 22px !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  
  /* Force render attributes to prevent hover invisibility */
  visibility: visible !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(49, 39, 130, 0.25) !important;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease !important;
}

.aw-letter-btn-primary i, 
.aw-letter-btn-primary span {
  color: #ffffff !important;
  visibility: visible !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

.aw-letter-btn-primary:hover {
  background-color: #251d66 !important;
  border-color: #251d66 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
  
@keyframes awFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes awModalIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.98); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}
  
/* ══ CARDS GRID (2 Columns) ═════════════════════════════════ */

  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
  width: 100%;
}
  
.aw-card {

  display: flex; 
  flex-direction: column; 
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: box-shadow .2s ease, transform .2s ease;

.aw-card:hover {

.aw-card-num { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slate-500); }

.status-green { background: #dcfce7; color: #059669; }
.status-amber { background: #fef3c7; color: #d97706; }
  
.aw-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--slate-900); margin-bottom: 24px; min-height: 44px; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; letter-spacing: -0.3px; }
  
.aw-card-meta-grid {
  display: grid; 
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); 
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.aw-meta-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.aw-meta-lbl { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slate-500); letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.aw-meta-val { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate-900); }
.aw-card-amount-colored { color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; }
  
.aw-card-foot {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  margin-top: auto;
}
.aw-btn-ghost-dark {
  background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8);
  color: var(--slate-700); border-radius: 99px; padding: 8px 16px;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s;
}
.aw-btn-ghost-dark:hover { background: var(--slate-50); }
  
.aw-btn-ghost-blue {
  background: #eff6ff; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
  color: #2563eb; border-radius: 99px; padding: 8px 16px;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s;
}

.aw-btn-ghost-blue[disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; background: transparent; border-color: #e2e8f0; color: #94a3b8; }
  
/* ══ RESPONSIVE ══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .aw-summary-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .aw-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .aw-ph-right { flex-wrap: wrap; }
}
  
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .aw-letter-facts { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .aw-letter-modal-header,
  .aw-letter-modal-body,
  .aw-letter-modal-footer { padding: 18px 20px; }

}]]></link><name>My Award</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function () {
    data.detail_page = options.detail_page_id || 'my_award_detail';
    data.sideBar = $sp.getWidget('sidebar_dashboard');

    // Handle incoming widget server action when "Acknowledge award" is clicked
    if (input && input.action === 'acknowledge_award' && input.sys_id) {
        var updateGr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_enno_gatenow_grant_awards');
        if (updateGr.get(input.sys_id)) {
            updateGr.setValue('applicant_response', 'acknowledged');
            updateGr.update();
        }
    }

    data.awards = [];
    data.totalAwarded = 0;
    data.activeAwardCount = 0;
    data.awaitingAckCount = 0;
    
    data.closingSoonestDate = '';
    data.closingSoonestProgram = '';

    var currentUser = gs.getUserID();
    var currentUserObj = gs.getUser();
    data.userInitials = (currentUserObj.getFirstName().charAt(0) + currentUserObj.getLastName().charAt(0)).toUpperCase();
    data.userDisplayName = currentUserObj.getDisplayName();

    var applicantIds = [];
    var applicantGr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_enno_gatenow_service_applicants');
    applicantGr.addQuery('user', currentUser);
    applicantGr.query();
    while (applicantGr.next()) {
        applicantIds.push(applicantGr.getUniqueValue());
    }

    if (applicantIds.length === 0) {
        return;
    }

    var applicantIdList = applicantIds.join(',');
    var responseFilter = 'pending,acknowledged,rejected';

    var awardGr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_enno_gatenow_grant_awards');
    awardGr.addQuery('applicant_response', 'IN', responseFilter);
    awardGr.addQuery('applicant', 'IN', applicantIdList);
    awardGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    awardGr.query();

    var nearestDateMs = null;

    while (awardGr.next()) {
        var responseValue = String(awardGr.getValue('applicant_response') || '').toLowerCase();
        var amount = parseFloat(awardGr.getValue('build_grant_amount') || 0);

        if (responseValue === 'pending') {
            data.awaitingAckCount++;
        }

        data.totalAwarded += amount;
        data.activeAwardCount++;

        var endDateStr = awardGr.getValue('award_end_date');
        if (endDateStr && responseValue !== 'rejected') {
            var gdt = new GlideDateTime(endDateStr);
            var currentEdMs = gdt.getNumericValue();
            
            if (!nearestDateMs || currentEdMs < nearestDateMs) {
                nearestDateMs = currentEdMs;
                var months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
                var monthIndex = gdt.getMonthUTC() - 1;
                data.closingSoonestDate = months[monthIndex] + ' ' + gdt.getYearUTC();
                data.closingSoonestProgram = awardGr.getDisplayValue('program_name');
            }
        }

        data.awards.push({
            sys_id: awardGr.getUniqueValue(),
            number: awardGr.getDisplayValue('number'),
            program_name: awardGr.getDisplayValue('program_name'),
            award_start_date: awardGr.getDisplayValue('award_start_date'),
            award_end_date: awardGr.getDisplayValue('award_end_date'),
            award_amount: amount,
            applicant_response: responseValue,
            applicant_response_display: awardGr.getDisplayValue('applicant_response'),
            grant_program_id: awardGr.getDisplayValue('grant_program'),
            award_letter: awardGr.getValue('award_letter') || ''
        });
    }
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>farheen.maqbool</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-19 08:10:09</sys_created_on><sys_id>7e1b4a2193fa0b10d444c9b877373c0d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>80</sys_mod_count><sys_name>My Award</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GateNow" source="x_enno_gatenow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="GateNow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_7e1b4a2193fa0b10d444c9b877373c0d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>farheen.maqbool</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-20 08:05:26</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="gn-layout">
